text.en:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Insolvensi (Pemohon bagi
Pendaftaran Penama) 2023.

Pemohon bagi pendaftaran penama

2. Bagi maksud subperenggan 2 G(1)(a)(iii) Akta Insolvensi 1967 , Lim Weng Hong
ditetapkan sebagai pemohon bagi pendaftaran penama.

Dibuat 16 November 2023
[MdI.BDPKS-600/3/1/1; PN(PU2)180/JLD. 5]

DATO' SRI AZALINA BINTI OTHMAN
Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri
(Undang-Undang dan Reformasi Institusi)

INSOLVENCY ACT 1967

INSOLVENCY (APPLICANT FOR REGISTRATION OF NOMINEE) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subparagraph 2 G(1)(a)(iii) of
the Insolvency Act 1967 [ Act 360 ], the Minister, on recommendation of
the Director General of Insolvency, makes the following order:
